name: Kandy
description: Home to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic and surrounded by misty hills covered in tea plantations. A UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Galle
description: A historic port city featuring a stunning 16th-century fort. Known for beautiful beaches, seafood restaurants, and colonial architecture.

name: Ella
description: A scenic mountain town surrounded by lush green valleys and tea plantations. Perfect for hiking, exploring nature, and experiencing hill station culture.

name: Colombo
description: The capital and largest city of Sri Lanka. Hub of commerce, culture, and dining with colonial heritage buildings and modern attractions.

name: Sigiriya
description: Home to an ancient rock fortress that rises 200 meters above the surrounding plains. A UNESCO World Heritage Site with stunning views.

name: Mirissa
description: A beautiful beach town famous for whale watching, golden beaches, and vibrant nightlife. Perfect for relaxation and water sports.
